en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph mounted on a dark background, showing a riverside or waterfront construction site with wooden barracks, stacks of timber, sand or gravel piles, temporary wooden walkways over the water, and a few workers. In the foreground are pilings or columns by the shoreline; in the distance low hills and a flat plain are visible. On the left margin, there is a vertical block of handwritten Cyrillic text in white ink.
